title: Skill frontmatter
description: Structural shape of the YAML frontmatter every SKILL.md must carry. Membership checks against the controlled vocabularies (category, stage, io_types) and semantic checks (trigger-phrased description, evidence base, dangling inputs, atomicity) live in scripts/validate.js against schema/taxonomy.yaml, not here.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier. Must match the skill's folder name.

title.description: Human-readable name shown in the catalogue.

description.description: Trigger conditions for invoking this skill, not a summary of what it does. Should read as 'Use when...' / 'Invoke when...', naming the user intent or input state that fires it.

category.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#categories.

stage.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#stages.

evidence_base.description: The frameworks or papers this skill operationalises. Every skill must cite at least one.

framework.description: Short name of the framework or method, e.g. 'COM-B' or 'Values affirmation'.

citation.description: Human-readable citation: authors, year, and title or venue.

url.description: Link to the paper or framework. Must be http(s) — this renders as a clickable link on the site.

weird_context.description: Whether the evidence base generalises beyond WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialised, Rich, Democratic) populations.

status.description: How far the underlying evidence has been tested outside WEIRD samples.

note.description: Optional caveat shown on the skill page, e.g. which populations the effect has or hasn't replicated in.

inputs.description: What this skill needs before it can run. Each type wires the dependency graph on the site.

type.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#io_types.

description.description: What this input is and what shape it should arrive in.

source.description: 'user' means a human supplies it directly; 'skill-output' means it's expected to come from another skill's output.

required.description: Set false for inputs the skill can run without. Omitting it means required.

outputs.description: What this skill produces. Each type wires the dependency graph on the site.

type.description: Must be an id from schema/taxonomy.yaml#io_types.

description.description: What this output contains and what a downstream skill or human can do with it.

authors.description: Who wrote or maintains this skill. Names or GitHub handles.

version.description: Semantic version. Bump it in the same commit as the change — the site derives each skill's changelog from git history of this field.
